name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration.

files.content:
---
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

type Props = HTMLAttributes<"option">

const { class: className, ...props } = Astro.props
---

<option
  data-slot="native-select-option"
  class={cn("bg-[Canvas] text-[CanvasText]", className)}
  {...props}
>
  <slot />
</option>

---
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

type Props = HTMLAttributes<"optgroup">

const { class: className, ...props } = Astro.props
---

<optgroup
  data-slot="native-select-optgroup"
  class={cn("bg-[Canvas] text-[CanvasText]", className)}
  {...props}
>
  <slot />
</optgroup>

export { default as NativeSelect } from "./native-select.astro"
export { default as NativeSelectOption } from "./native-select-option.astro"
export { default as NativeSelectOptGroup } from "./native-select-optgroup.astro"
